name: spellkave_set_metadata
label: Set Metadata
description: Set open metadata with one flat target/key/value update or an explicit atomic updates batch. target 'manifest' replaces one root metadata key, target 'namespace' registers one namespace, and target {kind, ref} upserts one object annotation. Attachment identity follows live admission: target_kind + target_ref + namespace + bundle_id; source and payload are replaced on a repeat call. The shared validator owns namespace payload semantics and admitted target kinds.

bundle.description: Owning bundle for namespace and attachment updates. Omit to use context.defaultBundle; manifest updates need none.

kind.description: An admitted metadata target kind. The shared manifest validator owns the current vocabulary; unsupported values fail at commit.

target.description: Singleton form: 'manifest' for a top-level [metadata] key, 'namespace' to register a namespace, or {kind, ref} to attach metadata to an admitted target. Omit when passing updates[].

key.description: Singleton form: the top-level [metadata] key, or the metadata namespace for a registration or attachment.

value.description: Singleton form: a JSON-compatible scalar, array, or object for target 'manifest'; {audience, description?} for target 'namespace'; an open metadata object for an attachment target.

source.description: Attachment source for the singleton attachment form; defaults to 'manifest'.

audience.description: Singleton attachment form: registers an absent namespace in this atomic call; never defaults.

description.description: Singleton attachment form: optional description when this call registers the namespace.

value.description: A JSON-compatible scalar, array, or object. Open metadata has no shared docs/UI schema.

audience.description: Explicit namespace audience; no implicit default.

on_demand.description: ADR-0130: reference content (rules text, creation data, docs) delivered only to a client that subscribes public_reference_metadata, never to a play session on connect. Defaults to false (kernel default) when omitted.

kind.description: An admitted metadata target kind. The shared manifest validator owns the current vocabulary; unsupported values fail at commit.

key.description: Registered metadata namespace for this annotation.

value.description: An open JSON-compatible metadata object. Values are authored unchanged: this shared tool does not reserve a docs, UI, or ruleset schema.

audience.description: Registers an absent namespace in this atomic call; never defaults.

description.description: Optional description when this call registers the namespace.

updates.description: Explicit atomic batch. Do not combine with singleton target/key/value fields; every update is validated before anything persists.
